additions.label: velora batchFillOrderWithTarget
additions.description: Typed order settlement under existing allowances with every maker/taker permit byte string constrained to exact empty bytes.
warnings: Static exact-deployment source/ABI inventory only; not live runtime identity, funding, liquidity, profitability, eligibility or successful execution attestation. Independent exact-function grants, pauses and canonical zero-native-value calldata controls remain mandatory.

Both taker and maker permit bytes must be exactly empty in every item, including caught, skipped and excess items. Empty bytes cause no external permit call; no approval, presignature or delegation is installed. Maker signature bytes remain ordinary settlement proof, including existing ERC1271 static checks.

Caller pays maker using existing allowance; maker pays target using existing allowance. target is a payout recipient, not an executor. Atomic batches revert all; try batches catch individual failures but require aggregate fill and self-delegatecall only a fixed typed settlement selector. No arbitrary executor or multicall vocabulary is admitted.

Maker-mode batches use ceil conversion before individual floor rounding. Scalar aggregate fill does not guarantee token homogeneity. Expiry zero means no expiry. Taker restriction, remaining fill, cancellation, signatures, amounts, rounding and token behavior remain protocol checks.

NFT packed types select fixed ERC20, ERC1155 with empty receiver data, or ERC721 safe transfer methods. Standard receiver hooks and token execution remain; no supplied arbitrary receiver payload is enabled.
